 It is thus obvious that Medwin had ready access to the holographs, or copies of them (Jane
Williams was a particular favourite of Medwin’s), in the year following S.’s death, and that
he was ready to combine together lines from the two poems, and to adapt them sometimes
quite freely. The passage incorporating lines from the paired poems precedes an account
of a drowning which is obviously based on S.’s death, and which includes the first publi-
